title: MetricObservability
description: Server-computed health rollup for a Metric, derived from the data quality of the assets the metric is computed on.

metricAssetDirection.description: A data asset linked to a metric, annotated with where it sits relative to the metric in the lineage graph.

direction.description: Where the asset sits relative to the metric. `upstream` assets feed the metric and drive its health, `downstream` assets consume it, and `unrelated` assets are linked but have no lineage edge to the metric.

affectsHealth.description: True only for a direct upstream Table, the sources included in Metric health.

health.description: Overall health band for a metric.

dimensionRollup.description: Data quality test results for one quality dimension, aggregated across the metric's upstream assets.

dimension.description: Name of the data quality dimension, for example Completeness or Accuracy.

total.description: Number of tests evaluated in this dimension.

failed.description: Number of tests with a Failed terminal result.

aborted.description: Number of terminal tests that aborted.

score.description: Pass rate for this dimension as a percentage.

assetRollup.description: Health contribution of a single upstream asset.

score.description: Pass rate for this asset as a percentage. Absent when the asset has no data quality tests.

total.description: Number of tests evaluated on this asset.

failed.description: Number of tests with a Failed terminal result on this asset.

passed.description: Number of successful terminal tests on this asset.

aborted.description: Number of aborted terminal tests on this asset.

latestRunTime.description: Most recent included terminal result on this asset.

redacted.description: True when the caller can see the aggregate contribution but not this source's identity or details.

testResult.description: A single data quality test contributing to the rollup.

asset.description: The asset the test runs against.

dimension.description: Data quality dimension the test belongs to.

status.description: Result of the most recent run.

timestamp.description: When the most recent run completed.

incident.description: An unresolved data quality incident on one of the metric's upstream assets.

testCase.description: The test case that raised the incident.

asset.description: The asset the incident is on.

statusCounts.description: Global latest-result counts used to compute the Metric score.

sourceCoverage.description: Coverage and redaction information for direct upstream tables.

reasonCode.description: Stable code localized by API clients.

health.description: Overall health band. Unknown when no upstream asset carries a data quality test.

score.description: Overall score as a percentage. Absent when health is Unknown.

rollupReason.description: Backward-compatible server explanation. Clients should localize reasonCode.

latestRunTime.description: Most recent included terminal result across all direct upstream tables.

partial.description: True when detail rows are redacted for one or more sources while global aggregates remain complete.

dimensions.description: Per-dimension breakdown of the contributing tests.

assets.description: Per-asset breakdown of the contributing upstream assets.

linkedAssets.description: Every asset linked to the metric, annotated with its lineage direction. Only the upstream ones contribute to the score, so this is what explains an asset's absence from `assets`.

tests.description: The individual test results behind the rollup.

incidents.description: Unresolved incidents on the metric's upstream assets.

upstreamAssetCount.description: Number of upstream assets linked to the metric.

evaluatedAssetCount.description: Number of upstream assets that carried at least one data quality test and therefore contributed to the score.
